problem: The cubic polynomial $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=-2,{x}_{2,3}=3\pm \text{i},$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $-1.$ Find $f(x).$

examples.knowledge_point: Finding a Cubic Polynomial Given One Real Root, Two Complex Roots, and a Leading Coefficient
examples.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13978465/assets/1c498dcdef2a71cc27117c2c0a43dd54074128ec3e5693e13a12d18b660d1cf4.png)

The Argand diagram above shows the roots of the cubic polynomial $f(x).$ Find $f(x)$ given that the coefficient of the cubic term is $1.$
examples.worked_solution:
From the diagram, we see that $f(x)$ has roots ${\color{black}x_1= 2}$ and ${\color{black}x_{2,3}=-2\pm \textrm{i}}.$ Additionally, we're given that the coefficient of the cubic term is ${\color{black}a=1}.$ 

Therefore, we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) \\  & =(x-2)(x-(-2+\text{i}))(x-(-2-\text{i}))\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}(x-2)(x-(-2+\text{i}))(x-(-2-\text{i})) & = \\ (x-2)({x}^{2}-x(-2-\text{i})-x(-2+\text{i})+(-2+\text{i})(-2-\text{i})) & = \\ (x-2)({x}^{2}+4x+5) & = \\ {x}^{3}+4{x}^{2}+5x-2{x}^{2}-8x-10 & = \\ {x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}-3x-10 & .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(x) = x^3+2x^2-3x-10.$

The cubic polynomial $P(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=0,$ ${x}_{2}=-4,$ and ${x}_{3}=7,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $-5.$ Find $P(x).$

$P(x)=$
{{field-1}}${x}^{3}\,+$
{{field-2}}${x}^{2}\,+$
{{field-3}}$x$
feedback.worked_solution:
Since our cubic polynomial has roots ${x}_{1}=0,$ ${x}_{2}=-4,$ and ${x}_{3}=7,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=-5,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) & =-5(x-0)(x-(-4))(x-7) \\  & =-5\,x\,(x+4)(x-7)\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}-5\,x\,(x+4)(x-7) & =-5\,x\,({x}^{2}-3x-28) \\  & =-5({x}^{3}-3{x}^{2}-28x) \\  & =-5{x}^{3}+15{x}^{2}+140x.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $P(x)=-5{x}^{3}+15{x}^{2}+140x.$
